literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe the same study (PMC8112172) using two constructs: GCaMP6s-MS4A12 (GCaMP6s fused N-terminally to full-length MS4A12) and 3×FLAG-MS4A12 (FLAG tag N-terminal). MS4A12 is a 4-pass TM protein whose N-terminus (residues 1–92) and C-terminus (residues 222–267) are both intracellular. The GCaMP6s fusion is therefore on the cytoplasmic face. The 3×FLAG tag is also N-terminal (naming convention 'FLAG-MS4A12') and likewise intracellular; no residue number is given. The two extracellular loops (ECL1: 114–127, 14 aa; ECL2: 184–200, 17 aa) are not mentioned in any ledger line as sites of tag insertion. No ledger line supports an extracellular tag insertion at any position in MS4A12. Zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: GCaMP6s fused N-terminally to full-length MS4A12 (pLenti6.3-GCaMP6s-MS4A12); the N-terminus of MS4A12 is intracellular (residues 1–92), so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
3×FLAG-MS4A12 sub-cloned into pCMV5; naming convention places FLAG at the N-terminus, which is intracellular (residues 1–92); no residue number is stated in the paper.
